resources.string: Voice coach is ready. Your music can stay on while I speak.
Average pace: %1$d minutes and %2$d seconds per kilometre.
One kilometre to your distance goal.
Distance goal reached within your target time. Well done.
Distance goal reached. Your active time is above your target.
You are slower than your target pace.
You are faster than your target pace.
You are back at your target pace.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_slower
string-array.item: You are a little behind your target. Pick it up gently if it feels comfortable.
There is room to lift the pace a little. Keep the effort controlled.
You have eased below your target speed. A small adjustment is enough.
Try a slightly quicker rhythm if you feel ready. No need to surge.
Your recent pace is slower than the goal. Build back into it gradually.
A gentle lift can bring you toward your target. Stay relaxed.
If you feel comfortable, find a slightly quicker rhythm here.
You are behind your pace target. Listen to your effort before speeding up.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_faster
string-array.item: You are going faster than planned. You can slow down a little.
You are ahead of your target pace. Ease back and save some energy.
Your pace is quicker than the goal. There is no need to rush.
A touch slower will bring you closer to your target. Stay comfortable.
You have picked up speed. Settle back into your planned rhythm.
You are moving faster than your goal. A gentler pace is fine.
Leave a little in reserve. You are ahead of your pace target.
Your recent pace is quick. Ease off slightly to match your plan.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_on_pace
string-array.item: That is it. You are back around your target pace.
Good adjustment. You are back in your target range.
Your pace has settled near the goal. Keep it comfortable.
You have found your planned rhythm again. Nice work.
Back on target. Small, steady adjustments are enough.
That recent adjustment brought you back toward the goal.
You are close to your target again. Stay relaxed.
Your recent pace matches the plan. Keep listening to your effort.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_settling
string-array.item: You are getting into the session. Find a rhythm that feels comfortable.
Nice start. Let the rhythm settle without forcing it.
Keep the opening effort comfortable. There is time to build.
You are underway. Relax your shoulders and find your rhythm.
Good to be moving. Settle in at an effort you can sustain.
Take the session one stretch at a time. Keep the effort comfortable.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_steady
string-array.item: Keep taking it one stretch at a time. You are doing the work.
Check in with your effort. It is fine to ease off when you need to.
Nice commitment. Stay relaxed and keep the next stretch comfortable.
Let the rhythm come to you. There is no need to force every step.
Keep your shoulders loose and choose an effort you can maintain.
You are putting time into your goal. Keep listening to your body.
Stay present for the next stretch. Small, steady steps add up.
Keep it comfortable. Finishing with something in reserve is a good option.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_halfway
string-array.item: You are past halfway to your goal. Keep the next part controlled.
More than half the goal is done. Take it one stretch at a time.
Halfway is behind you. Keep some energy for the rest.
You have passed the halfway mark. Stay with a sustainable effort.
Over halfway to your goal. Nice progress.
The first half is done. Keep listening to your effort for the next part.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_final
string-array.item: You are into the last part of your goal. Bring it home comfortably.
The goal is getting close. Keep the effort controlled.
You have covered most of your goal. Stay relaxed.
You are in the final stretch toward your goal. No sprint needed.
Not much of the goal remains. Keep a rhythm that feels good.
You are getting close to your goal. Finish at an effort that suits you.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_endurance
string-array.item: You have been moving for a while. Check your effort and take water if needed.
Good time on your feet. Keep the effort sustainable.
Consistency is adding up. It is fine to ease off or take a break.
Keep the next stretch manageable. Comfort matters more than forcing the pace.
You are building time on your feet. Stay aware of how you feel.
Take a moment to check in with yourself. Adjust the effort if you need to.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_uphill
string-array.item: On this climb, let the pace ease and keep your effort comfortable.
This looks like an uphill stretch. There is no need to chase your flat pace.
It looks like you are gaining height. Keep the effort controlled.
The route appears to climb here. Shorter, comfortable steps may help.
The path is rising. Ease the pace if the effort rises.
This stretch seems uphill. Keep something in reserve instead of chasing speed.

string-array.name: coach_phrase_downhill
string-array.item: On this descent, keep the pace controlled and watch your footing.
This looks downhill. Stay comfortable rather than chasing extra speed.
It looks like you are losing height. Keep your steps controlled.
The route appears to descend here. Leave room to react to the path.
The path is descending. Choose control over extra speed.
This stretch seems downhill. Keep an eye on the surface ahead.

resources.string: Slower than the lap before. Keep the effort comfortable.
Same pace as the lap before. Nice consistency.
The %1$s of the lap took longer this time.
GPS height rose through that section, so a slower pace can be sensible.
